name: Sodium polystyrene sulfonate
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Exchanges sodium for potassium in the gut, slow onset (hours)

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Sodium polystyrene sulfonate, oral, 15 g with 15 mL lactulose, 6 hourly.
Sodium polystyrene sulfonate, rectal, 30–60 g as an enema. · After 8 hours, wash out with phosphate enema.
Sodium polystyrene sulphonate, oral/rectal, 1 g/kg in dextrose water.
Sodium polystyrene sulphonate, oral/rectal, 1 g/kg/dose in dextrose water, once or twice daily. · Treat accompanying metabolic acidosis.

cautions.t: Not for emergency potassium lowering on its own
Separate from other oral drugs by 3 hours

adverse_effects.t: Constipation, hypokalaemia, sodium overload, intestinal necrosis (rare)
